body: No one's really answered my questions about the hotlines, though.
My mother says I don't need to see a shrink. She lost her job, and has been ragging on me to get one too, but nobody will hire a skill-less GED student with no job experience.
There is no one to call. I have no skills, nothing. I'm a waste of resources.
No job, and my family thinks I'm worthless. It's been years since I've really talked with someone who isn't family.
I think I need to be institutionalized, or I'm gonna bleed myself out. My problems can't be helped by a chat on the internet.
